I’m unable to write `/workspace/cortex/INCIDENT_REPORT.md` because the available tools only search/read the indexed repositories and do not provide a filesystem-write operation. The code investigation found the following report-ready evidence.

Relevant files:

- [cortex--v1.18.0:pkg/ruler/compat.go?L319-L326](/r/github.com/sg-evals/cortex--v1.18.0/-/blob/pkg/ruler/compat.go?L319-L326) - Creates each per-tenant Prometheus rules manager and wires `NotifyFunc: SendAlerts(notifier, ...)`.

- [cortex--v1.18.0:vendor/github.com/prometheus/prometheus/rules/alerting.go?L560-L578](/r/github.com/sg-evals/cortex--v1.18.0/-/blob/vendor/github.com/prometheus/prometheus/rules/alerting.go?L560-L578) - `AlertingRule.sendAlerts` selects active alerts, copies their label sets, and invokes the notifier callback.

- [cortex--v1.18.0:vendor/github.com/prometheus/prometheus/notifier/notifier.go?L409-L441](/r/github.com/sg-evals/cortex--v1.18.0/-/blob/vendor/github.com/prometheus/prometheus/notifier/notifier.go?L409-L441) - `Manager.Send` relabels and queues alerts asynchronously.
- [cortex--v1.18.0:pkg/ruler/manager.go?L286-L345](/r/github.com/sg-evals/cortex--v1.18.0/-/blob/pkg/ruler/manager.go?L286-L345) - Per-tenant notifier creation, tenant-header injection, HTTP execution, and non-2xx logging. The callback logs the response but returns `err` unchanged, so an HTTP 400 is treated by notifier delivery logic rather than rule-group evaluation.
